description: Liste der Solaranlagen und Windkraftanlagen in Münster is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Open.NRW. Diese Daten werden aus dem Marktstammdatenregister der Bundesnetzagentur bezogen. Die Daten werden regelmäßig aktualisiert. Das Datum der letzten Datenaktualisierung kann dem Repository entnommen werden, in dem die Datei bereitgestellt wird. Coverage: Münster.NRW. The portal files it under the publisher Open.NRW. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
